answer: Make trust a willow raft, not a ticket printed at signup: a newcomer lashes together poles of useful work, each pole checked by a different veteran and marked with a plume of distinct signatures, so a copied raft shows repeated lashings and sinks. The raft must pass ember-ballast tests, random trials where it carries extra weight and proves fresh, verified work or loses buoyancy. Standing grows only as new poles are added, each bound to one key. Sybil farms must build, lash, and float a separate raft for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
